templates.why_chosen: High-confidence layered exemplar of a stepwise zoom: 16 replicated Sorting Cores collapse into one expanded core, linked by a dashed containment line to a further-expanded, blue-highlighted unit below, across 2 panels and nesting depth 3.
templates.what_to_learn: Chain two successive zoom-ins top to bottom, engine to one core to one sub-unit, using dashed connector lines to mean containment rather than dataflow, and highlight only the final, most novel block in accent colour; the record's own weakness warns to label small symbols like a comparator explicitly instead of relying on convention.

templates.why_chosen: Three containment levels drawn top-to-bottom (Sorting Engine -> Sorting Core -> MSU+) with the focal unit highlighted in blue.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw each level once, connect levels with dashed leaders, and reserve the accent fill for the innermost novel unit.

templates.why_chosen: A stepwise zoom runs from the 16-core Sorting Engine list into one Core's layout, then into the MSU+'s dual-buffer filter-and-mux detail, joined by dashed lines, with the final, most-novel block highlighted in light blue.
templates.what_to_learn: Chain dashed zoom connectors through two levels (engine to core to sub-unit) and reserve one accent colour (light blue) for only the deepest, most novel block so the eye knows exactly which of several nested boxes is the actual contribution; label every symbol explicitly, since this figure's unlabelled '>' comparator relies on visual convention alone.
